tools.name: get_board
tools.description: The live advertising board: 2 slots a day of 12 hours each, showing which are held, by whom, for how much, and which are free. A slot with isFree true can be claimed for nothing with claim_free_slot.

tools.name: get_slot_price
tools.description: What it costs to take a specific slot right now: zero if nobody holds it, otherwise the amount a bid has to beat.

tools.name: claim_free_slot
tools.description: Put a product on the board in a slot nobody holds. Costs nothing: an empty slot has no standing bid to beat, so any amount takes it, zero included. No account and no card. tools.description: Every brand that has held or contested a twelve-hour advertising slot, newest attention first, optionally filtered to one category. tools.name: get_brand_stats
tools.description: The published numbers for one brand: slots held, card opens, and click-throughs to its own site. These are the same figures anyone can read on the site.

tools.name: list_winners
tools.description: Brands that held a slot when it closed — plus whoever is leading the live slot right now — ranked by what they paid, over the last 7 days, 30 days or a year. Optionally filtered to one category.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: How much attention the board actually sends: visitors, page views, and click-throughs to brands. Published rather than claimed — this is a small board and the numbers say so.
